data.acquired_before_this_protocol: official label tables (stats-REST goalie/summary, skater/summary, api-web schedule) acquired by nhl_engine_feasibility_data.py with schema-only inspection (field names, one season's row counts, starter / period-type value sets); NO analysis result was computed
existing_sources: cached API play-by-play of 7,923 games (2017-2023) for event-level reconciliation
data.seasons: 2017-2025 regular season (2017 history only for any later modelling)

kind: DATA / IDENTIFIABILITY FEASIBILITY AUDIT -- no model is fit, no challenger exists, no hyperparameter is chosen
never: a model fit or performance score
a postgame quantity masquerading as a pregame feature
2024/2025 as selection data for any future head's design (they stay previously-exposed years)
output_rule: every question gets MEASURED numbers and one verdict from the closed set given in the question; a failed question is reported, never waved through
principle: full independent outcome distributions; POINTS should eventually be generated consistently from the joint goals / assists process, not kept as an unrelated binary classifier (legacy points classifier: LEGACY_FAILED)

S1_label_coverage.measure: set equality of (game, player) rows between the stats-REST skater/summary scoring table and the frozen Phase 1A skater table, per season; null rates of goals / assists / points

S2_points_identity.measure: points == goals + assists for EVERY row; evGoals + ppGoals + shGoals == goals; evPoints + ppPoints + shPoints == points; goals <= shots; per season

S3_cross_source_reconciliation.measure: per player-game, stats-REST goals / assists vs API play-by-play goal events (scoringPlayerId, assist1PlayerId, assist2PlayerId; shootout excluded) on the 7,923 cached games (2017-2023): exact-match share, mismatch classes

S4_team_goal_reconciliation.measure: per team-game: sum of skater goals vs the schedule final score; the shootout winner's +1 in the final score (skater goals exclude it); empty-net and OT goals

S5_conversion_inputs.measure: goals per shot, history depth (prior goals / shots of the same player under the cutoff rule), zero-shot rows, per-position conversion; coverage of players with >=10 prior appearances

S6_season_consistency.measure: field null rates and basic semantics per season 2017-2025 (assists per goal, points per game, PP goal share) - any structural break is flagged

S7_joint_structure.measure: descriptive joint distribution of (goals, assists) per player-game, assists per team goal (<=2 assists per goal), dependence of assists on team goals; no model fit

requires: POINTS == GOALS + ASSISTS reconciles exactly in the frozen historical sources before points can be derived from the joint process
